lines:
Fixed the reported continuation regression. Read-only inspection of the affected saved Chat (chat.56f7feea0c9795ce653fc2c2128fe3be6919911b) found three prepared executions with unchanged frozen authority and a valid Stop boundary. Its original shell and Python descriptions differed from the current catalog following the managed-job implementation. Re-freezing those descriptions on a new input changed the binding/graph comparison and raised the reported error.
Continuation now looks up the original prepared Run before rebuilding and preserves its native descriptions in both follow-up preparation and exact-request validation. It does not rewrite user history, replay cancelled effects, or relax schema/configuration/credential/permission checks. MCP definitions remain strict. New Chats use current catalog descriptions.
Verification: 349 desktop library tests passed; one diagnostic fixture is intentionally ignored by default and was run separately successfully using a read-only exported copy of the user's actual prepared record. The captured-record test reproduced the pre-fix mismatch, then validated the continuation with identical original snapshot and manifest and zero provider calls. Current frozen Chat tool configuration/options were independently confirmed identical to the stored bindings. Upgrade/replay tests prove original model-facing descriptions persist across restart and genuine timeout, approval, provider or context changes still fail before effects; MCP description drift remains visible. Native Windows UI test passed Stop, same Chat/Run continuation, and continuation after restart alongside concurrency/navigation/draft/recovery isolation (six provider calls). Evidence: desktop/src-tauri/target/native-concurrency-1789667806675/result.json and stopped-chat-continued.png. Native build and git diff --check passed. Critical task-end audit passed. Existing running app needs restart to load the rebuilt fix; no new Chat or data repair is required.

data.description: Confirmed on the user's saved Chat: original frozen context hash is unchanged; persisted shell/Python descriptions differ from the newly installed catalog and re-freezing descriptions changes the snapshot on follow-up. Preserve original descriptions for existing native bindings in follow-up and exact-request validation, without weakening schema/configuration/credential/permission checks or MCP definition checks. Add upgrade/Stop/restart regression coverage, read-only verification against the affected saved Chat, and real native Stop/continue proof. Preserve all user history; no database rewrite or forced new Chat.
data.title: Fix continuation after Stop across native tool description updates
